answer: Locks are entered in signal, expire in pulse, and ferrous lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An farming party running 178 aliases therefore needs 76 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 546 identities would post 3430 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
